lines.原地旋身扫腿，打身边一圈。伤害 15，冷却 4 秒；没有霸体的敌人会被打退、硬直: Spin on the spot and sweep everyone around you. 15 damage, 4 s cooldown; foes without super armour are pushed back and staggered.
lines.气息悠长：生命上限 100 → 120；脱离战斗 3 秒后开始回血，每秒 5 点: Long, even breath: max HP 100 → 120; out of combat, HP starts coming back after 3 s at 5 per second.
lines.闪避落地后 0.3 秒内再按闪避，可以再闪一次（七成远）。两次都闪完才开始冷却。: Within 0.3 s of landing a dodge, dodge again (70% as far). The cooldown starts after both.

lines.兔儿，近来你的名望渐起，为师在殿里都听说了。: Rabbit, word of your growing renown has reached me even here in the hall.
lines.为师有一路「燕回旋」：原地旋身，一腿扫开身边一圈。: I have a move called Swallow Spin: turn on the spot and sweep away everyone around you with one leg.
lines.不过招式再巧，护不住自己也是白搭。去和你师兄切磋一场，同一场里格挡住他三招，输赢: But the cleverest move is worthless if you can't protect yourself. Spar with your Senior Brother and block three of his blows in one bout — win or lose.
lines.做到了，再回来找为师。: When you've done it, come back to me.
lines.同一场切磋里，格挡住你师兄三招。看准他出手的那一下再挡，莫慌。: Block three of your Senior Brother's blows in one bout. Wait for the moment he strikes, then block. Don't panic.
lines.看好了——腰带着腿走，脚下生根，身子像燕子回巢。: Watch closely — the waist leads the leg, the feet take root, the body turns like a swallow returning to its nest.
lines.（照着师父的样子转了一圈……差点把自己绊倒。）: (He copies Master and spins once… and nearly trips over himself.)
lines.哈哈，多转几回就顺了。徒儿，往后按 U 使出这一招。: Ha! A few more turns and it'll come smoothly. From now on, my boy, press U to use it.
lines.徒儿，打架靠的不只是手脚，还有一口气。: My boy, fighting takes more than hands and feet. It takes breath.
lines.殿里的蒲团，你挑一个坐下，按 E 打坐，静坐一夜，到明早辰时再起来。: Pick a cushion here in the hall, sit, press E to meditate, and stay still through the night until 08:00 tomorrow.
lines.只是这一坐就是一整夜，今天没办完的委托会作废，你自己掂量着来。: But it takes the whole night — any errand not finished today will be void. Weigh it up yourself.
lines.蒲团就在殿里。坐上去，按 E 打坐，一夜不动。: The cushions are right here in the hall. Sit, press E to meditate, and don't move all night.
lines.一夜没动，气也匀了。为师把吐纳的法门传给你。: A whole night without moving, and your breath has evened out. I'll teach you the Breathing Art.
lines.一夜没动，气息也匀了。为师把吐纳的法门传给你。: A whole night without moving, and your breath has evened out. I'll teach you the Breathing Art.
lines.吸要长，呼要缓，气沉丹田。往后受了伤，你也好得快些。: Breathe in long, breathe out slow, sink the breath low. From now on your wounds will heal faster.
lines.兔儿，你的身法还差一口气。: Rabbit, your footwork is still missing something.
lines.去练武场的梅花桩试炼，拿个「银」回来。从前拿过银或金的，也算数。: Go to the Plum Post Trial in the training yard and bring back a Silver. A Silver or Gold you earned before counts too.
lines.梅花桩，拿到银再来。脚下要快，眼要尖。: The Plum Posts — come back with a Silver. Quick feet, sharp eyes.
lines.梅花桩上能拿银，脚下已经有根了。: Silver on the Plum Posts — your feet have found their roots.
lines.这路「踏雪二段闪」：闪出去刚一落地，趁脚下那点余力，再闪一次。: This is the Snow-Step Double Dodge: the moment you land a dodge, use what's left in your feet and dodge once more.
lines.像在雪地上走，只留下一个印子。学会了，就一直跟着你。: Like walking on snow and leaving a single print. Once learned, it stays with you.
lines.静坐吐纳，一直坐到明早辰时 08:00。跳过去后，今天没做完的委托会作废。: Meditate until 08:00 tomorrow morning. Errands not finished today will be void after the skip.
